title: Unique Morse Code Words
description: Transform a list of words into Morse code and count the number of unique transformations.
pseudocode:
1. morse = ["-.-", "---", ...]
2. transformations = new Set()
3. for word in words:
4.   code = ""
5.   for char in word:
6.     code += morse[char.charCodeAt(0) - 97]
7.   transformations.add(code)
8. return transformations.size
